svg.text: U2 supplies the Pico rail only • U3, U4 and RGB power require U1 • Paper review
Blue values open manufacturer documents. * Exact manufacturer or order code open.
Matching remote labels and rails join electrically. X is deliberate NC. See POWER-REVIEW.md for fit and power holds.
Automatic Pico power, with qualified U2 preferred
U2 feeds SYS5 only. A5 takes over when B5 falls below the selection threshold.
Switchover can dip or reset the module. Check actual rail limits and J2 current.
IC6 and U4 draw only from A5, regardless of the selected SYS5 source.
Direct U4 D+/D- remain connected when U1 is off. Check attached-device behavior.
